title: Evaluate REA providers for XEX and PPC analysis
goal: Assess official morluto/rea tooling for reproducible MW3 analysis without treating an MCP wrapper as a recompiler.
acceptance: Pin tool/provider versions and verify big-endian PPC/XEX/VMX128 support or explicit limitations
Compare synthetic and owned-title evidence with independent tools; no auto-install or external upload of game bytes
validation: Run synthetic PPC/xref fixture and private title-slice checks if supported
Record capabilities, failures and provider license requirements
